title.en: The One With the Fake Boyfriend

description.es: Marta y Fina se quedan a solas en la tienda. Cuando Fina menciona que la salud de Isidro ha empeorado de forma preocupante, Marta la mira con ternura y le toma la mano. Fina le dice que no la trate así, que se aleje de ella, porque la está confundiendo. Marta le sugiere que podrían ser amigas, pero Fina no quiere. Para hacer feliz a su padre, Fina le pide a Gaspar que finja ser su novio, pero Gaspar se niega y discuten.
description.en: Marta and Fina are left alone in the store. When Fina mentions that Isidro's health has taken a troubling turn, Marta looks at her tenderly and takes her hand. Fina tells her not to treat her this way, to stay away from her, because she is confusing her. Marta suggests they could be friends, but Fina does not want that. To make her father happy, Fina asks Gaspar to pretend to be her boyfriend, but Gaspar refuses and they argue.
